title: Workout offer reminders can keep coming after the gym's plan stops including workout offers
what: When a gym's MettleUp plan does not include workout offers, the offer card on the Gym tab hides. But the phone keeps its last saved copy of the offer, and the automatic 9:30 am reminders are planned from that saved copy. So the member can still get 'Your workout offer ends on ...' or 'extra days added' for an offer they can no longer see. The same happens when the gym refuses the offer read. Dormant today because the gym plan switch is off for everyone.
expected: When the offer card is hidden because the plan does not include offers, the saved offer is dropped too, so no offer reminder is planned.
who: members of a gym on a plan without workout offers, once plan limits go live
how_often: every morning until the saved offer ends
fix_line: When the plan does not include offers, forget the saved offer and plan the reminders again

title: Reminders that say 'Check in and train today' can arrive on a day the gym is closed
what: The phone knows the gym's opening hours, weekly off day and holidays (the Gym timings page and the busy card use them). The automatic reminders never look at them. 'Almost there: check in and train today' and 'We haven't seen you, come in when you can' move to the next free morning, which can be the gym's weekly off day or a holiday the gym set.
expected: Reminders that ask the member to come in skip days the gym has marked closed and move to the next open day.
who: members of gyms that set a weekly off day or holidays
how_often: whenever a come-in reminder falls on a closed day
fix_line: Give the reminder planner the gym hours and skip closed days for come-in reminders

title: After asking to renew in the app, the member is still told to renew at the front desk
what: A member taps Renew my plan, picks a plan and sees 'Request sent. The desk will confirm.' Only the plan card reads that waiting request. The 'Your plan ends on Friday. Renew at the front desk.' card on the Workout tab and the plan-ending reminders never look at it, so the member keeps being asked to do what they already did until the desk approves it.
expected: While a renewal request waits, the Workout tab card and the plan-ending reminders say the renewal is asked and waiting for the desk, or stay quiet.
who: members whose plan ends soon and who asked to renew in the app
how_often: every day between the request and the desk answer
fix_line: Let the plan-ends card and plan reminders see a waiting renewal and change their words
